text_en: When they had finished eating and drinking they wanted to retire; so they took the young man and brought him into the bedroom.
text_cn: 吃喝完毕以后，他们要睡觉去，便领少年人进了那间小房。

text_en: Then Tobias remembered the words of Raphael, and he took the fish’s liver and heart out of the bag where he had them and put them on the embers of the incense.
text_cn: 那时多俾亚想起辣法耳的话，便从袋中拿出所存的鱼肝和鱼心，放在香炉的火炭上。

text_en: The odor of the fish so repelled the demon that he fled to the remotest parts of Egypt. But Raphael followed him, and at once bound him there hand and foot.
text_cn: 鱼的气味制伏了恶魔，使他逃往埃及的内陆去。辣法耳也追去，把他捆在那里，倏忽间就回来了。 ──

text_en: When the parents had gone out and shut the door of the room, Tobias got out of bed and said to Sarah, “Sister, get up, and let us pray and implore our Lord that he grant us mercy and safety. ”
text_cn: 人们出去以后，他们俩关上了房门。多俾亚便从床上坐起来，对她说：“妹妹，起来！我们一同祈祷，祈求我们的上主，在我们身上施行仁慈和保佑。

text_en: So she got up, and they began to pray and implore that they might be kept safe. Tobias began by saying, “Blessed are you, O God of our ancestors, and blessed is your name in all generations forever. Let the heavens and the whole creation bless you forever.
text_cn: 她便起来，于是一起开始祈祷，祈求上主保佑他们；他便开始祈祷说：“我们祖宗的天主，你是应受赞美的！你的名号是世世代代应受颂扬的。诸天及你的一切造物，都应赞颂你于无穷之世。

text_en: You made Adam, and for him you made his wife Eve as a helper and support. From the two of them the human race has sprung. You said, ‘It is not good that the man should be alone; let us make a helper for him like himself. ’
text_cn: 是你造了亚当，是你造了厄娃作他的妻子，作他的辅助和依靠，好从他们二人传生人类。你曾说过：一人独处不好，我要给他造个相称的助手。

text_en: I now am taking this kinswoman of mine, not because of lust, but with sincerity. Grant that she and I may find mercy and that we may grow old together. ”
text_cn: 上主，现在我娶我这个妹妹，并不是由于情欲，而是出自纯正的意向。求你怜悯我和她，赐我们白头偕老！”

text_en: And they both said, “Amen, Amen. ”
text_cn: 他们互相答说：“阿们！阿们！”

text_en: Then they went to sleep for the night. But Raguel arose and called his servants to him, and they went and dug a grave,
text_cn: 随后便睡了一夜。

text_en: for he said, “It is possible that he will die and we will become an object of ridicule and derision. ”
text_cn: 那时，辣古耳也起来，便叫他的仆人同他一起出去掘坟，因为他说：“恐怕他死了，我们又要受到讥笑与辱骂。”

text_en: When they had finished digging the grave, Raguel went into his house and called his wife,
text_cn: 他们掘完了坟墓，辣古耳回了家，叫了妻子来，

text_en: saying, “Send one of the maids and have her go in to see if he is alive. But if he is dead, let us bury him without anyone knowing it. ”
text_cn: 说：“你打发一个女仆进去看看他是死是活，假如他死了，我们马上埋了他，不让外人知道。”

text_en: So they sent the maid, lit a lamp, and opened the door; and she went in and found them sound asleep together.
text_cn: 她遂打发女仆去，女仆拿着灯，开了门，进去，看见他们还在一起安睡。

text_en: Then the maid came out and informed them that he was alive and that nothing was wrong.
text_cn: 女仆便出来，报告说：“他还活着，没有什么不好。”

text_en: So they blessed the God of heaven, and Raguel said, “Blessed are you, O God, with every pure blessing; let all your chosen ones bless you. Let them bless you forever.
text_cn: 他们便赞美天上的大主说：“天主，你应受一切纯洁和神圣的赞扬！愿众人永远赞美你！

text_en: Blessed are you because you have made me glad. It has not turned out as I expected, but you have dealt with us according to your great mercy.
text_cn: 你是应受赞扬的，因为你使我快慰，没有让我预料的事发生，却按你的大慈大悲恩待了我们。

text_en: Blessed are you because you had compassion on two only children. Be merciful to them, O Master, and keep them safe; bring their lives to fulfillment in happiness and mercy. ”
text_cn: 你是应受赞扬的，因为你怜悯了这两个独子独女。主啊！赐予他们慈惠和保佑，使他们一生满享快乐慈惠吧！”

text_en: Then he ordered his servants to fill in the grave before daybreak.
text_cn: 随后，吩咐仆人在天亮以前，把坟墓填平。

text_en: After this he asked his wife to bake many loaves of bread; and he went out to the herd and brought two steers and four rams and ordered them to be slaughtered. So they began to make preparations.
text_cn: 他又吩咐他的妻子预备很多食物；他自己走到家畜群里，牵出两头牛和四只羊来，命人宰杀了，开始准备一连十四天的婚筵。

text_en: Then he called for Tobias and swore on oath to him in these words: “You shall not leave here for fourteen days, but shall stay here eating and drinking with me; and you shall cheer up my daughter, who has been depressed.
text_cn: 随后，他叫了多俾亚来，向他宣誓说：“这十四天的婚筵未完结以前，你不可离开这里，你要在我这里住下吃喝，好抚慰我女儿破碎了的心灵。

text_en: Take at once half of what I own and return in safety to your father; the other half will be yours when my wife and I die. Take courage, my child. I am your father and Edna is your mother, and we belong to you as well as to your wife now and forever. Take courage, my child. ”
text_cn: 凡我所有的，你立刻可带去一半，平安回到你父亲那里。那另一半，待我和我妻子死后，也是你们的。 孩子，放心吧！我是你的父亲，厄得纳是你的母亲。从现在起，我们永远是你的，也是你妹妹的。孩子，放心吧。”
